title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 371 (Effect of registration under this Part)

content.overview: When a company is registered in pursuance of this Part, all provisions contained in any Act of Parliament or other law, or in any deed, settlement, contract or other instrument constituting or regulating the company, including the memorandum and articles if registered, shall apply as if the company had been formed under this Act, subject to the provisions of this Part and with necessary adaptations.
content.glance: On registration under this Part, governing instruments and applicable laws apply as if the company had been formed under this Act (with adaptations).
